planSteps.description: Login with email superadmin@local.com and password password at https://demo2.tradefreedoms.com/login
Login successful as superadmin
Navigate to /admin page
Admin dashboard loads with statistics cards (total users, deposits, withdrawals, trades) and navigation sidebar
Click on Users in the admin sidebar or navigate to /admin/users
Admin users page shows a table of registered users with search and filter options
Navigate to /admin/deposits
Admin deposits page shows a table of deposit requests with approve/reject actions
Navigate to /admin/withdraws
Admin withdraws page shows a table of withdrawal requests with approve/reject actions
Navigate to /admin/settings
Admin settings page shows grouped settings sections for site configuration
Navigate to /admin/trades
Admin trades page shows trading history table
Navigate to /admin/deposit-methods
Admin deposit methods page shows list of cryptocurrency deposit addresses
Navigate to /admin/kyc
Admin KYC page shows KYC verification requests table
Navigate to /admin/tickets
Admin tickets page shows support ticket list
Navigate to /admin/option
Admin option settings page shows option trading configuration
Navigate to /admin/database
Admin database page shows database management interface
